Class StrategyDTO

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.dto.StrategyDTO
public class StrategyDTO extends Object
Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to deserialize strategy blueprints from the JSON configuration file.

This class acts as a flexible data container. To keep the JSON structure flat and avoid creating a massive class with dozens of specific and null variables, it utilizes Jackson's JsonAlias to dynamically map different contextual JSON properties into generic numerical payload slots (num1, num2, num3).
